Jack Heart, 2026-11-13, added two things to this Task.

1. On the bug "a refused or interrupted attempt marks a finished run failed": "This should be part of 56". Reproduced by Manabot QA against 105abdd: on a finished run, a second `track` block that raises (a refused resume, or KeyboardInterrupt) before logging any row changes the run state from finished to failed while keeping its reached clock. Mechanism as read then: Run.__init__ records the attempt eagerly and Run.__exit__/finish writes failed unconditionally; Attempt.first_row starts True so it is not evidence a row was logged. A genuine failure before the first row must still be reportable, so skipping every rowless exception is not enough. Details: scratch/implementation.md and scratch/plan.md on Manabot branch jack-heart/aa55a0-move-run-execution (MTG-329).

2. On EXP-37 (Design training recovery across interruptible GPU rentals): "Fold this one into 56". EXP-37 is completed as folded here. Its brief asked for more than this Task has delivered; check which of these this Task already answers and say what remains: recording the actual acquisition mode and distinguishing preemption, host disappearance, lease expiry and learner failure; durable incremental checkpoint publication with acknowledged durability; one cumulative budget and deadline across retries, transfer, idle time and teardown; the application declaring its restorable state and any discontinuity (fresh streams versus exact continuation) rather than Etude inferring equivalence from weights; controlled fault-injection fixtures for loss before and after checkpoint commit, partial upload, duplicate completion and controller restart; and a Manabot adoption path. EXP-37 full text stays readable on that Task.

Not decided by this note: whether these hold the release.
